name: NeUDF Hierarchical Importance Sampling
definition: A two-stage sampling strategy: first sampling 64 points uniformly, then performing importance sampling for another 64 points using a view-invariant density derived from the UDF value itself.
summary: NeUDF Hierarchical Importance Sampling is a two-stage strategy that decouples sampling from rendering to balance UDF gradients, using a tailored weight function that distributes weights before surface intersection.
